name: 77316 · Montgomery, TX
findings: ZIP 77316 (Montgomery) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77316 (Montgomery) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77316 (Montgomery) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
